name: native collection replacer keeps requested custom properties
source: function main(): void { const native = new Map<string, number>(); native.set("a", 1); const m: any = native; m.extra = 7; m.missing = undefined; m.inf = Infinity; console.log(JSON.stringify(m, ["size", "extra", "missing", "inf"])); const set = new Set<number>([1, 2]); const s: any = set; s.extra = "kept"; console.log(JSON.stringify(s, ["extra", "size"])); }
